claim_boundary: The frozen primary conditional estimand is supported only for insect evaluation species in the response-blind pre-mask panels. Any later positive result may support order-conditioned transfer among geographically co-supported insects in this sampled phylogatR domain; it must not be generalized to Animalia broadly. The exact confirmatory survivor domain must be re-reported after character-mask admissibility without changing thresholds.

report: number of primary-eligible evaluation species by taxonomic order
species-equal mean paired increment within each represented order
unweighted mean of the represented-order means
descriptive_robustness.interpretation: These summaries diagnose whether the species-equal primary mean is concentrated in the numerically dominant order. They have no p-value and cannot rescue, overturn, or redefine the frozen primary decision.
